author: Andrew Koenig and Jacob Dechowski, Columbia Missourian
title: Southern Boone volleyball sweeps Sedalia
text:
Southern Boone volleyball swept Sedalia in three sets Thursday.
The Eagles won the first set 25-20, the second set 25-6 and the final set 26-24 to complete the sweep.
